findings.finding: Successful migration retained production_runner_identities in terminal state after removing the exact runner containers. Later database-status and ALREADY_MIGRATED treated expected absence as PRODUCTION_RUNNER_MISSING.
findings.required_remediation: After proven retirement, durably clear runner identities. If a crash leaves them in a terminal state, use exact identity-checked retirement where exact absence is allowed, then clear state before the first DB read.
